title: Aureline M5 output-provenance-chip-group component
description: Documents the controlled vocabulary the output_provenance_chip_group family binds inside the frozen M5 notebook-kernel-output component matrix (schemas/ui/m5-notebook-kernel-output-component-matrix.schema.json). An output provenance chip group names what produced an output and how completely its execution lineage resolves so a chip group never severs an output's canonical provenance or hides a drifted execution count. The Rust validator in crates/aureline-notebook is the authoritative gate; this schema documents the family's shape.
